entry_points.text: Table type uses segmented handling when enable set else contiguous, consulting config only on capable CPUs.
Three low-level module entries share host context preserving progressively more return state.
Module install needs at least header length with valid params and stable online set across all CPUs.

exports.text: SNP setup needs host capability and table success then arms crash hook; shutdown clears RMP and crash flushes caches.
RMP lookup reports state and level; smash uses privileged op; frames move between guest-private and shared.
Loader info query forwards output address via serialized path safe for stack memory.
CPU enable is idempotent; shutdown clears markers for re-init; final activation refreshes version.
Teardown absorbs busy and retries resumable while silencing software codes; scrub zeroes only on erratum CPUs.
Early init partitions KeyIDs reserving one for metadata, blocks on too few IDs or hibernation, gates memory, clears suspend, marks capability, manages guest IDs.
Domain ops by root address: create, key config, init, finalize, VP flush, flush done, key free, track, with detail registers on init and measurement.
Page and VP ops add control and measured pages, manage tables, block, extend, remove, reclaim, access fields, create and enter, with detail registers and GPA level IDs selectors.
Cache writeback forwards resume flag via leaf 40; page writeback uses key-protected addresses for root and explicit keys via leaf 41.

hazards.text: Leak quarantine warns, counts every frame, and optionally captures per-frame diagnostics.
Module failures map protection fault to EOPNOTSUPP, undefined instruction to EACCES, absent module to ENODEV, others to EIO with context.
Missing required non-clobber guarantee in module capabilities aborts initialization.
Affected server generations force bug flags for partial private writes causing later checks and VMCS loss without no-invalidation indication.

invariants.text: Segment size and mask derive from shift; contiguous needs ordered reserved range; segmented enforces shift limits.
Direct map narrows only when needed; update prepares mapping, retries overlap, faults with diagnostics on failure.
Calls need preemption disabled, mark cache incoherent, retry only bounded entropy shortage via wrappers.
Accepted payloads convert to physical lists with version zero and update scenario; install forwards block address.
Global init runs once with cached result; metadata access reads one field by identifier.
Convertible list skips low MB staying ordered disjoint; TDMR size scales with reserved count; PAMT from one NUMA allocation.

Coverage rounds to coarse bounds, provisions PAMT and reservations with fence and power-two table; gaps and PAMT overlaps become ordered disjoint exclusions; exhaustion or overlap aborts with diagnostics.
Key config is once per package serialized with prior invalidation or stale copies corrupt on concurrency; domains share stable root; handed pages are flushed; secure level is host level minus one.
Unassociated is shared, reserved private only inside PAMT; enable needs XSAVE MOVDIR64B self-snoop; going-online allows only fully contained ranges.
Keyed address places identifier above implemented physical width combined with frame base.

locks.text: Leaked list uses dedicated spinlock; loader serializes on raw spinlock; update phase uses IRQ-safe raw spinlock.
Global init outcome uses sysinit spinlock; module update exclusion toggles preemption.
Convertible list mutates under hotplug guard; usable list builds under online-mem read lock matching notifier; TDMR list uses read barrier after publication.

state_machines.text: Update advances start to done only after all online CPUs ack each phase; any failure halts and counters reset.
Workers act once per phase; CPU zero does global shutdown and activation while all do install and enable.
Bringup takes virt reference before enable and releases after flush; final package CPU retained while keys allocated; shutdown disables module before cache maintenance via power callbacks.

Init goes discovery, validation, enumeration, TDMR coverage, config, per-package keys, per-TDMR init tracking base and size with unwind; TDMRs init incrementally with reschedule; enable registers hotplug then publishes.

structs.text: Packed loader block and image header carry counts and address lists with 104B and 4076B reserved; limits 1 sig 496 mod, version 0x200, magic TDX-BLOB, calls 0x8000000000000000 and 0x8000000000000001, scenario 1; acceptance needs exact length and zeroed reserved.
Module state holds init flags with per-CPU markers and TDMR list; convertible nodes store frame range and nid; TDMR list tracks storage stride and counts with per-region base size.

TDMR descriptor holds base size with per-granularity PAMT bases and sizes plus variable offset-size tail; 512B alignment for descriptor and array, 1GiB span; RMP uses bits 13-51; shift 16, types 0 and 1.

System info aggregates version features TDMR limits PAMT sizes control sizes masks and CPUID tables; selectors cover features limits sizes and indexed leaves; handoff 0x8900000100000000 versions 0x0800000100000003/4/5; reads chain with capacity checks.

TDH leaves: VP_ENTER 0, MNG_ADDCX 1, PAGE_ADD 2, SEPT_ADD 3, VP_ADDCX 4, PAGE_AUG 6, RANGE_BLOCK 7, KEY_CONFIG 8, MNG_CREATE 9, VP_CREATE 10, MNG_RD 11, MR_EXTEND 16, MR_FINALIZE 17, VP_FLUSH 18, VPFLUSHDONE 19, KEY_FREEID 20, MNG_INIT 21, VP_INIT 22, PAGE_RDMD 24, VP_RD 26, RECLAIM 28, REMOVE 29, SYS_KEY_CONFIG 31, SYS_INIT 33, SYS_RD 34, LP_INIT 35, TDMR_INIT 36, TRACK 38, VP_WR 43, SYS_CONFIG 45, SHUTDOWN 52, UPDATE 53, DISABLE 69.
